do_not_regress: Use AST-assisted heuristic split audit as read-only evidence when available.
Keep AST audit outputs under project show_project_to_AI support, never under the ownership-free transient garbage root.
Use multi-island candidate queue at module start.
Allow at most two independent islands in one patch.
Use non-conflicting write checks rather than impossible no-shared-read checks.
Do not stack multiple ZIP patches before validation/freeze.
Allow outer patch-train delivery bundles only as packaging for separate governed patch ZIPs.
Keep every inner patch in a patch train on its own install -> validate -> freeze sequence.
Do not freeze a patch train as one vague outer-bundle entry.
Do not proceed to later train patches if an earlier inner patch fails.

Allow up to four ordered patch ZIPs in one sequential double-refactor delivery train only when each inner ZIP is independently installable, validatable, contract-checkable, freeze-preppable, previewable, and freezeable.
Keep the default maximum at two related refactor slices per inner ZIP.
Individually validate and individually freeze every inner ZIP before the next ZIP is installed.
Do not freeze a sequential delivery train as one outer-bundle memory entry.
Avoid unnecessary micro-files; do not create tiny helper modules merely to reduce line count.
Use ordinary importable .py files for runtime/source logic; ZIP payload folders are delivery packaging only.
Every resulting Python source file in the Large File Refactor Workbench flow must be 101-499 physical lines with no structural-role exceptions and no padding.
Planner owns architecture; Workbench may veto but must not merge, split, rename, or reassign the selected Planner architecture.
Preview, Shadow, and real apply must use the same sealed exact payload bytes.
Refactor Large Module requires semantic-first review, warning acknowledgment, transaction-summary confirmation, final basis recheck, canonical Patch 5 proof, and the serial project mutation lane.
Patch 6 controlled real-module proof must cover first apply, exact rollback restoration, fresh second apply, COMPLETED_VALIDATED, receipt integrity, and unchanged live source.
Place controlled validation project copies and disposable Shadow fixtures under the transient garbage root; never create drive-root sibling validation projects.
KPR-06-003 is target-specific source/audit truth; KPR-06-004 is reusable process awareness and must not override current target evidence.
Use exact target path, SHA-256, byte length, and newline contract for KPR-06-003 identity checks.
Use consumer/public-contract preflight and semantic-safety evidence as decision support, never autonomous architecture authority.
Require behavior equivalence, consumer compatibility, dependency direction, semantic dynamic safety, strict 101-499 compliance, and fresh touched-family AST audits before SAFE release claims.
Use descriptor-driven governed release construction when applicable and preserve root-drive to delete_after_daily_work verified staging.
Freeze is evidence preparation only until human Preview Freeze Entry and explicit Confirm and Write.

PEP 8 compliance, SOLID responsibility/dependency design, and DRY implementation are canonical; count after compliant formatting and create cohesive helpers rather than compressing formatting or duplicating logic to satisfy the size gate.
title: Large Module Creation and Refactor Protocol
